ANNOUNCEMENT OF ZOOM OPERATIONS COMMITTEE 
MEETING AGENDA 
When: September 1, 2026 
7:00PM  
Location- Zoom 
 
To join the meeting virtually, please click the link below to join the webinar: 
https://hamden.zoom.us/j/87004373288?pwd=XnvFYEDhE3tnObzY7ARj1udE6slktc.1  
Passcode:036533 
 
Telephone: +1 646 558 8656, +1 646 931 3860, +1 301 715 8592, +1 305 224 1968 
Webinar ID: 870 0437 3288 
Passcode: 036533 
 
Note: Any member of the public may request, in writing, a physical location and “any electronic equipment necessary” to attend the 
meeting in real-time. Said request shall be made to tdonnarummo@hamden.org not less than twenty-four (24) hours prior to the 
meeting. 
For those who wish to make Public Comments: Time will be allotted for public comments at the beginning of 
the meeting. We ask that public comments be limited to no more than 1 minute in length. You may also submit 
your comment in writing. Public comments should be sent to PublicInput@hamden.org, with the message's 
subject stating the meeting's name and date (for example, “May 12 Operations Committee Meeting”). Public 
comments will be accepted up to 1pm the day of the meeting. Please note the following: 
• The name and Hamden address of the person submitting public comment must be included in the 
message. 
• Remarks should be brief and concise, with a maximum length of three minutes (about 450 
characters). 
• Comments should start with a 2-3 sentence summary. The summary will be read instead of the entire 
message if there is a large number of comments and reading each of them in their entirety would 
extend beyond the time allotted for public comment. 
 
1. Call to order and roll call 
2. Public Comments on Agenda Items 
3. Additions to the Agenda 
4. Information Item 
a. Discussion on district building repair schedule 
b. Discussion on building heating/cooling concerns 
c. Discussion of RFQ for Energy Savings Performance Contracting Services 
d. Discussion of the donation of 4 youth-sized soccer goals by Hamden Soccer Association (HSA) 
e. Discussion of possible extension of First Student transportation contract and potential savings 
 
5. Action Items 
a. Approval of the donation of 4 youth-sized soccer goals by Hamden Soccer Association (HSA) 
b. Approval of the building use by the Hamden Senior Services to use gymnasium at 60 Putnam 
Ave. on October 19th, 21st, 23rd, 26th, 28th, 29th from 9:30am-11am for Exercise for Seniors 
Program 
c. Approval of the building use by the Hamden Regional Basketball League to use the gym at Bear 
Path on October 19, 2026 and February 21, 2027 from 5:30-7:30pm and 8:30am-12:30pm for 
skills evaluations 
d. Approval of the building use by the Hamden Regional Basketball League to use the gym at Bear 
Path Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday starting December 1, 2026 to February 25, 2027 from 
5:30-9:30pm for youth basketball practices 
e. Approval of the building use by the Hamden Regional Basketball League to use the gym at Bear 
Path on Saturdays starting December 5,2026 to March 15, 2027 for youth basketball games 
f. Approval of the building use by the Hamden Regional Basketball League to use the gym at
Spring Glen on Saturdays starting December 5,2026 to March 13, 2027 for youth basketball 
games 
g. Approval of the building use by the Hamden Regional Basketball League to use the gym at West 
Woods on Saturdays starting December 5,2026 to March 13, 2027 for youth basketball games 
h. Approval of the building use by the Hamden Regional Basketball League to use the gym at 
Hamden Middle on Tuesdays and Thursdays starting December 1,2026 to March 4, 2027 for 
youth basketball practices 
 
 
6. Adjournment
